samples.summary: The newly documented contract ("every path that replaces cell data without recalculating has to derive the blocker map again") is applied to `undo`, `redo` and `initialize`, but not to `reloadDimensions`, the path invoked when a remote collaborative change arrives. It reloads `loadMerges()` — and merged blocks are now themselves spill blockers per `findSpillBlocker` — yet never calls `loadSpillBlockers()`, so after a remote merge/unmerge or remote cell replacement the map is stale and a cleared blocker never re-queues its anchor (permanent `#REF!` for the receiving client). Given this repo is collaboration-first (Yorkie store), this is the highest-traffic load path and is the one the change misses.
samples.evidence: reloadDimensions(): loadDimensions/loadStyles/loadMerges/loadFreezePane/loadFilterState/loadHiddenState/loadPivotDefinition — no loadSpillBlockers, unlike initialize() (line 424) and Sheet.undo/redo (sheet.ts:5103, 5140).

samples.summary: Scope well beyond the originating task plan. The task doc (docs/tasks/active/20260822-sheets-merge-refusal-notice-todo.md) asks for three things: a refusal reason hook, refusal messages in the view/frontend, and `consumeSpillBlocker()` in `moveRangeTo`'s two clearing loops. The diff additionally changes user-visible spill semantics (merged blocks now block spills → new `#REF!` states), rewrites ghost-travel behaviour for `moveRangeTo` and cut-`paste`, adds `clearCellForOverwrite`, `recalculateWithUnblocked`, and a whole new persisted-state derivation path (`loadSpillBlockers`) wired into undo/redo and document open. The design docs were updated (good), but the task plan was neither amended nor its checkboxes ticked, so the PR's stated scope and its actual scope diverge and the extra behaviour changes ship unreviewed against any acceptance criteria.
samples.evidence: Plan lines 27-41 vs. diff adding findSpillBlocker merge rule, loadSpillBlockers, ghost materialization in paste, merge/unmerge/autofill contract changes.

samples.summary: Task-doc discipline: every plan checkbox is still `[ ]` while the paired `*-lessons.md` narrates the work (including the follow-on merge/paste/loadSpillBlockers fixes) in the past tense as completed. Per CONTRIBUTING the plan is the execution record; leaving it entirely unchecked makes it useless for judging what shipped.
samples.evidence: todo.md lines 27-41 all unchecked; lessons.md lines 32-61 describe the same work as done.

samples.summary: `refusalMessage` uses a `default:` arm for `merge-autofill` instead of an exhaustive switch over `RangeOpRefusal`. Any future refusal reason added to the union will silently render the autofill copy rather than failing typecheck — the opposite of what the one-union/one-hook design in the lessons doc is meant to buy.
samples.evidence: switch (refusal) { case 'merge-source-split': ... case 'merge-dest-partial': ... default: return "Can't autofill across merged cells..." }

samples.summary: `Spreadsheet.onNotice` duplicates the shape and the host handling of the existing `onValidationError` channel (both `(message: string) => void`, both wired to `toast.error` in sheet-view.tsx). The plan sanctions a sibling channel, but a single `onNotice`-style message channel with a category would avoid a third parallel hook the next time a model message needs surfacing. Also, a refused gesture is a notice, not an error — `toast.error` may be the wrong severity in the host.
samples.evidence: spreadsheet.ts:405 onValidationError → toast.error (sheet-view.tsx:1014) and spreadsheet.ts:414 onNotice → toast.error (sheet-view.tsx:1020).

samples.summary: `loadSpillBlockers` scans the entire formula grid and, per blocked anchor, re-scans its whole footprint with awaited per-cell store reads. It now runs on every `undo`/`redo` — an interactive hot path — as well as on document open. For large workbooks this makes undo cost proportional to total formula count rather than to the undone change (`result.affectedRange` is already available and could bound it), which looks like the wrong granularity for the layer.
samples.evidence: loadSpillBlockers() iterates store.getFormulaGrid() and calls findSpillBlocker per blocked anchor; called unconditionally in undo (5103) and redo (5140).

finding.summary: The newly documented contract ("every path that replaces cell data without recalculating has to derive the blocker map again") is applied to `undo`, `redo` and `initialize`, but not to `reloadDimensions`, the path invoked when a remote collaborative change arrives. It reloads `loadMerges()` — and merged blocks are now themselves spill blockers per `findSpillBlocker` — yet never calls `loadSpillBlockers()`, so after a remote merge/unmerge or remote cell replacement the map is stale and a cleared blocker never re-queues its anchor (permanent `#REF!` for the receiving client). finding.evidence: reloadDimensions(): loadDimensions/loadStyles/loadMerges/loadFreezePane/loadFilterState/loadHiddenState/loadPivotDefinition — no loadSpillBlockers, unlike initialize() (line 424) and Sheet.undo/redo (sheet.ts:5103, 5140).

verdict.reason: Verified the absence directly. `reloadDimensions()` (packages/sheets/src/view/worksheet.ts:5219-5242) reloads dimensions/styles/merges/freeze/filter/hidden/pivot and re-resolves anchors, but never calls `loadSpillBlockers()` — matching the reviewer's evidence. The contrasting paths do call it: `initialize()` at worksheet.ts:424 (explicitly commented "After the merges: a merged block blocks a spill") and `Sheet.undo`/`Sheet.redo` at sheet.ts:5103 and sheet.ts:5140. The contract is documented at docs/design/sheets/calculator.md:83-87 ("a path that replaces cell data without calculating ... has to derive it again with sheet.loadSpillBlockers"), and calculator.md:65-68 confirms a merged block is itself a blocker, so a remote merge/unmerge arriving via loadMerges leaves the map stale. Counterexample search came up empty across the whole chain, not just the obvious spot: repo-wide grep for loadSpillBlockers yields only worksheet.ts:424, sheet.ts:5103, sheet.ts:5140 and the definition at sheet.ts:1039 (plus one test); the remote path sheet-view.tsx:1278 (doc.subscribe 'remote-change') -> scheduleRemoteSync:1170 -> runRemoteSync:1144 -> reloadDimensions:1153 has no re-derivation, and the optional follow-up `recalculateCrossSheetFormulas` (sheet.ts:3147-3166) is not equivalent — it only recalculates cells in crossSheetFormulaSrefs, returns early when that set is empty, and only runs when needsRecalc is true. Spreadsheet.reloadDimensions (view/spreadsheet.ts:103-105) is a bare delegation, and loadMerges (sheet.ts:512-515) only rebuilds the merge cover map, never the blocker map. Blocking under the design-fit lens as a spec/design-doc conformance gap: the canonical design doc states the contract over a class of paths, and the implementation applies it to only some members of that class while omitting the collaboration-first remote load path.
